notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) cosmetic run/drop trail material, two identical copies (Afterglow + CloudBurst/Conduit): same exports, parameter defaults, switch defaults and compiled uniform-expression set, so one family. EVIDENCE: decoded root exports (parameter nodes, switch defaults Has Mask/NoiseRotatorSpeed true, UseEdgeGradientMask false, Use Noise false, Add/Multiply true; both textures SAMPLERTYPE_LinearGrayscale; DynamicParameter slot 0 'Opacity'); 13 function calls (LinearGradient x1, SmoothStep x4 = root/tip/2 edge, CheapContrast x3, PannerRotatorFPS, PannerRotatorFPSUV1, TransluscentToonErosion, CameraDepthFade, DropTrailRibbonFade); the inline shader-map uniform-expression sets of both roots and 82 instance permutations, whose order is the compile order (Emissive, then Opacity). EMISSIVE = particle colour x Brightness: the SelectionColor RGB swizzle (read after Emissive is compiled) is the 2nd vector in 84/84 permutations, so Emissive reads no mask/noise/tile/contrast vector; Brightness is scalar #0 in 84/84. Controls: DiffuseAlphaErodeTrailBase01_FxM (emissive texture scale before the swizzle) and the premultiplied sibling Peacock_Trail_PreMultiplied01_FxM (same scalar order, every mask/contrast vector before the swizzle). OPACITY order: RootSS, CC(mask,RootMaskContrast) [mask panner compiled inside], TipSS, CC(mask,TipMaskContrast), [EdgeGradientMax, EdgeGradientMin, 1-EdgeGradientMin] (before Edge Softness 42/42), clamp(Edge Softness,0.01,1), Camera Fade, max(Depth Fade,1e-5), GradientMasksBrightness (after Depth Fade 84/84), [NoiseContrast, panner, NoiseBrightness] (after GMB 72/72), DropTrail*. Same layout in siblings Trail_Erode_Noise01_FxM, RunTrailFlowMap, StoneDropT_FXM, DragonMajesty_Trail01_FxM, Energy_Ring01_FxM; M_InskyPannedTexture has 'Opacity Boost' in GMB's slot. Emitter data agrees that GMB scales a late alpha term: haze trails pair GMB 0.6 with DynamicParameter peaks 2-5, every add-mode instance with EdgeGradientMin 0.75 uses GMB 5, the ES 0.001 core trails use GMB 2. materials.json per-instance switches match every compiled permutation. AUTHORED (wiring stripped): root/tip SmoothSteps on LinearGradient U (positions along UV0.x); field = RootSS*CC(mask,RMC)*TipSS*CC(mask,TMC)*edge (product, matching the compile order; a SmoothStep custom node registers its Min/Max only after compiling its X, so TipGradientMin/Max before TipMaskContrast rules out CC-as-X for the tip block, and the root block by symmetry; sibling M_TrailBase_Pattern shows the opposite nesting RMC, 0-RMC, RootGradientMin/Max, RMC+1, i.e. the order does discriminate); edge = SS(EdgeMax,EdgeMin,V)*SS(1,1-EdgeMin,V); toon erosion saturate((field-(1-opacity))/clamp(ES,0.01,1)), opacity = vertex alpha * dyn0; camera/depth fades and GMB each multiply the eroded alpha in the compiled order, then the noise is combined with that alpha (GMB could instead scale a cached copy of the gradient masks, which the order cannot exclude); noise = CC(NoiseTexture on UV1, NC)*NoiseBrightness, switch true = multiply (the 63 true instances carry trail-art strips -- flight lines, vines, bolts on black -- that only read as shapes inside the masked silhouette), false = add INSIDE the eroded alpha, op + n*op = op*(1+n) (the 9 false instances use generic fractal/caustic/crack noise with tuned edge/taper masks, e.g. DragonMajesty NC 50 / NB 5 / EdgeGradientMin 0.5; a bare op + n, which the uniform order cannot exclude either, ignores those masks and fills the raw ribbon strip with hard-edged noise blobs, so it was rejected; the switch name order 'Add / Multiply' would suggest true = add, but the trail-art instances contradict that); panner internals (tile, rotate about 0.5 in rad/s, pan with FPS-stepped time); MF_DropTrailRibbonFade approximated and disabled (drop_trail_fade=false) because the lab camera is inside its 9-12 m radius. Ribbons in this lab get no dynamic parameters (cascade.gd), so the emitters' 'Opacity' curves are missing on ribbons.
